changes_made.explanation: Normalized criteria to positive forms (Fluency instead of Not Fluent), added missing guideline details about evaluation scale, and improved clarity of guideline descriptions

overall_notes: The paper focuses on ad text generation using reinforcement learning with coverage-based rewards. The extraction was generally accurate but contained redundant entries and inconsistent naming. Major improvements include normalizing metric names, consolidating duplicate entries, and clarifying human evaluation methodology. The paper does not use LLMs as judges - it only uses them as generation models (Llama-2-7B).
